name: CryptoKoyn
description: The domain that owns CKY — the fungible currency of the platform — the wallet surface and the public account record.

acceptedAnswer.text: CKY is the fungible currency of the platform: token id 0 of the shared ObjectLayerToken contract. Every token id above zero is an ItemLedger asset.

mainEntity.name: Can I hold or trade CKY today?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The domain is Pre-Alpha: the contract is written and tested but not deployed to a public network, so no CKY balance is authoritative. Supply, staking, governance and fiat bridges belong to Phase 3 of the roadmap.
In your browser. The domain serves the wallet surface and the public account record only. It never receives a private key, a mnemonic or any other secret material.

mainEntity.name: Is the Cyberia coin balance the same as CKY?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The coin balance Cyberia runs off-chain is game progress state. CKY is ledger state. The two never mix.
